newsitem.title: UK: Vodafone gains as Hoare repeats "buy".
newsitem.headline: Vodafone gains as Hoare repeats "buy".

text.p: Vodafone Group rose four pence to 234-1/2 pence after broker ABN AMRO Hoare Govett repeated its buy recommendation for the mobile phone operator.
Analyst James Ross said he reiterated his positive stance as he expects imminent management changes to be followed shortly afterwards by some favourable strategic decisions.
Vodafone earlier this month appointed Chris Gent as chief executive, effective from December 1.
"We think Chris Gent will think of new initiatives and once he begins to run the company on a day-to-day basis the impact will become visible in the company's strategy," he said.
